text:
sam_oncall: :rotating_light: seeing elevated provisioning errors and control-plane 5xx from eu-central (eu-central-1). Alerts started ~03:10 UTC. GPU pool reporting repeated eviction races and API timeouts. Can we investigate and decide on traffic tilt?

maya_sre: I see the same in logs — control-plane API latencies are spiking and node provision attempts are timing out (30s+). Metrics: provisioning_succeeds down ~60% vs baseline.

leo_infra: tagging this. Is this the control-plane DB replication lag or network flap? early signs point to a control plane actor queue backlog.

frank_net: net team noticed increased egress errors on the eu-central edge for a subset of availability zones ~03:08. Other regions not affected. Might be a transit provider flap causing slow control-plane connectivity to nodes.

alin_prodeng: we should avoid full region cutover until we confirm fallbacks. Suggest a gentle tilt to eu-west and eu-north with a 20% shift first, monitor for 5m, then escalate. Also we should disable scale-to-zero in eu-central to prevent thrash.

sam_oncall: agreed. I'll kick the tilt and disable scale-to-zero. Command I'll use:```bash
# tilt 20% traffic away from eu-central pools to eu-west and eu-north
redwoodctl traffic set --from-region eu-central --to-region eu-west,eu-north --percent 20 --reason "eu-central control-plane instability"
# disable scale-to-zero for eu-central GPU pools
redwoodctl pool update eu-central-gpu --min-instances 2 --auto-scale false
```

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4663 "eu-central provisioning instability". Paging oncall group: @oncall-ing-infra. Runbook: https://console.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-4663.

maya_sre: after the tilt, I also suggest adding a short cache bypass for control-plane reads in the routing layer to reduce API calls, e.g., add TTL override 30s for agent-records.

leo_infra: good call. I'll push a conservative change:```yaml
routing:
  control_plane_cache_ttl: 30s
  aggressive_prefetch: false
```

frank_net: network team will open a ticket with transit provider, but in parallel we should pre-warm eu-west capacity for suspected surge. I'll allocate a 10% burst pool there.

sam_oncall: done the tilt and disabled autoscale. Monitoring panels: provisioning_succeeded (eu-central) still low but request error rate down ~15% overall. Keeping tilt at 20% for now.

maya_sre: alert thresholds relaxed temporarily? we should avoid paging for every provisioning drop while we stabilize. Recommend suppressing non-critical provisioning alerts for 15m.

sam_oncall: will suppress non-critical provisioning_alerts:europe for 15m.```bash
kubectl annotate configmap alerting suppress-provisioning-eu="15m" --namespace monitoring
```

alin_prodeng: quick cost note — sustained tilt and pre-warm will add ~2–3% short-term infra cost. OK with product? we should log the cost hit in the incident ticket.

leo_infra: logging cost estimate into INC-2026-4663. Also prepping a fallback plan: if eu-central fails below 30% capacity, we'll enact full failover with DNS tilt and capacity pinning in other regions. Need agreement to proceed if threshold hit.

maya_sre: agree on threshold. also attach a checklist for the handoff: router change commands, CDN invalidation steps, and customer comms template.

sam_oncall: summary for next shift / handoff: 1) Tilt at 20% to eu-west/eu-north (in place), 2) Autoscale disabled in eu-central, min instances 2, 3) control-plane cache TTL=30s, 4) Pre-warmed eu-west burst pool +10%, 5) Suppressed non-critical provisioning alerts for 15m, 6) Incident INC-2026-4663 created.

frank_net: network ticket: NET-7882 opened with transit provider, linking INC-2026-4663.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation policy updated to route eu-central incidents to oncall-ing-infra -> oncall-ing-ops. Handoff note saved.

sam_oncall: handing off to @maya_sre in 15m. If anything drops below threshold (eu-central capacity < 30% or provisioning_succeeds < 40%) escalate to full failover.

maya_sre: taking handoff. I'll monitor dashboards and run the DNS tilt play if threshold is crossed. Leaving a brief status in the incident ticket and this thread every 10m.

sam_oncall: thanks — leaving now, ping me if you need the routing keys. :thumbsup:

maya_sre: quick checkpoint 10m later: tilt holding, eu-central error rate improving slowly, no further evictions observed. Will keep monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=investigating -> stabilizing. Next update scheduled in 20m.
